acceptance: DuckDB loads Vortex, DuckLake and Iceberg without to_pylist.
Test asserts the factory returns the native handler for each format.
description: DuckDB's handler factory (duckdb.py:893-923) only routes Delta, CSV and Parquet. When it returns None, FileFormatRegistry (base/data_loading.py:1831-1859, fallback at :2062/:2100) picks generic Delta/DuckLake/Iceberg/Vortex handlers (base/data_loading.py:1080-1390) that read the full table to Arrow, call to_pylist(), then executemany. DuckDBVortexHandler (base/data_loading.py:1395) and DuckDBDuckLakeHandler (base/data_loading.py:1206) exist but are not returned by the factory (DuckLake is used only in tests/integration/test_open_table_formats.py:909). Wire them in; for generic handlers on engines that accept Arrow, use INSERT ... SELECT FROM the Arrow table.
